roadmap.title: Roadmap to the first internal release

sections.heading: Milestones
bullets: M1 — domain types compile with property tests on signed arithmetic
M2 — CSV reader round-trips a 10k-row fixture byte-identically
M3 — SQLite writer passes the balance invariant suite (sum of entries == account balance)

sections.heading: Risk register
bullets: money as f64 is the classic trap — entries carry i64 minor units from day one
csv parsing of quoted fields: adopt a crate rather than hand-rolling

points: domain knows nothing about io, so the balance invariant is testable without a database
the only public entry type constructor validates amounts, making negative-money bugs unrepresentable
no async runtime until M3 forces the question
no migration framework before the sqlite writer lands
